request.spec:
Show on each person their settled-total (the due of their SETTLED claims that count, at
their frozen figures, corrections included) and their open-total (the due of their OPEN and
PENDING claims that count: a held, deferred or retired-and-excluded claim is left out as it is
from the due-total). Show the sheet's settled-total and open-total too, each simply everyone's
figure added up (not trimmed). The two must add up to the person's untrimmed due-total before the
cap.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Show on each person their settled-total (the due of their SETTLED claims that count, at
their frozen figures, corrections included) and their open-total (the due of their OPEN and
PENDING claims that count: a held, deferred or retired-and-excluded claim is left out as it is
from the due-total). Show the sheet's settled-total and open-total too, each simply everyone's
figure added up (not trimmed). The two must add up to the person's untrimmed due-total before the
cap.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Each person's row now shows a settled-total and an open-total, and the sheet shows both added up across everyone. `bin/e2e` passes all 4 acceptance tests; after it passed I only added a comment, and didn't re-run it.

All the changes are in `src/main/frontend/src/app/features/people/people.ts`. These figures are calculated in the browser, so the server, database and audit file didn't need to change.

- **Person figures:** a new `splitOf(person)` goes through the claims that already count toward the due-total, so held, deferred and retired-and-excluded claims are left out as they are there. Each claim's due is added to "settled" if the claim is SETTLED (at its frozen figure) or to "open" if it is OPEN or PENDING. Corrections are included.
- **Due-total:** the existing calculation of the due-total before the cap is now settled + open from that same split, so the two always add up to it.
- **Sheet figures:** `splitTotal` adds up everyone's settled and open figures with no trimming of the highest and lowest. They're shown as `rollup-settled-total` and `rollup-open-total`.
- **Screen:** two new columns, "Settled due" (`person-settled-total`) and "Open due" (`person-open-total`), sit next to the due-total. There's also a new line under the sheet totals.
